content.text: During a rally in Seoul on March 3, 2024, a placard is held by a doctor, stating "Save Emergency Physician to Protect Emergency Patients," in opposition to the government's proposed increase in the annual enrollment quota for medical schools.

During a rally in Seoul on March 3, 2024, a doctor displays a sign that says "Save Emergency Physician to Protect Emergency Patients" in opposition to the government's proposal to increase the yearly enrollment quotas at medical schools.
